title: Response of a Rotational System to Sinusoidal Torque Input
expert_review: Solid problem for reinforcing Laplace-domain analysis and steady-state sinusoidal response in rotational systems.
learning_objectives: Apply Laplace transforms to sinusoidal inputs
Analyze system responses using transfer functions
Perform partial fraction expansion with complex poles
Distinguish between transient and steady-state behavior
Interpret physical meaning of mathematical response components
